responsibility: This distributed support header provides inline libm-style routines implemented directly with Motorola 68881 floating-point instructions. It defines HUGE_VAL and inlines functions such as sin, cos, exp, log, sqrt, atan2, pow, rounding operations, and scaling/exponent helpers using fp register constraints and explicit 68881 opcodes, sometimes managing fp control-register rounding modes or errno paths. It is a target-specific runtime convenience header for exploiting 68881 hardware, not part of GCC’s internal backend implementation.
